meta.name: baoyu-diagram
meta.description: Create professional, dark-themed SVG diagrams of any type — architecture diagrams, flowcharts, sequence diagrams, structural diagrams, mind maps, timelines, illustrative/conceptual diagrams, and more. Use this skill whenever the user asks for any kind of technical or conceptual diagram, visualization of a system, process flow, data flow, component relationship, network topology, decision tree, org chart, state machine, or any visual representation of structure/logic/process. Also trigger when the user says "画个图" "画一个架构图" "diagram" "flowchart" "sequence diagram" "draw me a ..." or uploads content and asks to visualize it. Output is always a standalone .svg file.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任何系统或流程自动生成专业深色SVG图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速把复杂结构或流程变成清晰图表
copy.tagline_en: Generate professional dark-themed SVG diagrams from any system or process
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly turn complex structures or processes into clear diagrams

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按描述画深色主题的 SVG 图——架构图、流程图、时序图、思维导图、时间线、状态机等类型;每次输出单个独立 .svg 文件,并生成 @2x PNG。
howto.when: 当你要求画任何技术或概念图(如 系统结构、流程、数据流)时触发,包括上传内容让你可视化;或直接说「画个图」「画一个架构图」「diagram」等。

say.text: 帮我画一张微服务的架构图
say.note: 生成深色主题 SVG 并转成 @2x PNG

say.text: 把这段登录流程画成流程图
say.note: 流程图带 Yes/No 分支

say.text: 把这篇文章画成时间线
say.note: 输出时间线 SVG 和 @2x PNG

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude draws dark-themed SVG diagrams — architecture, flowchart, sequence, mind map, timeline, state machine and more — as one self-contained .svg file, then exports a @2x PNG.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for any technical or conceptual diagram (system structure, process, data flow) or upload content to visualize, or say things like "draw a diagram", "画一个架构图", "flowchart".

say_en.text: Draw an architecture diagram of this microservice system
say_en.note: Saves an SVG and a @2x PNG

say_en.text: Turn this login flow into a flowchart
Make a timeline diagram from this article
say_en.note: Returns a timeline SVG plus @2x PNG
